ai_summary: Anupam Rasayan India Limited has completed the acquisition of a controlling stake in Bliss GVS Pharma, a strategic move to forward integrate into finished pharmaceutical formulations and establish a comprehensive global pharma platform. The transaction, largely funded by non-controlling, non-voting instruments from financial investors, is expected to be earnings-accretive, significantly boosting the combined entity's pro-forma revenue to over ₹4,000 crore while leveraging Bliss GVS Pharma's underutilized manufacturing capacity. No immediate red flags are apparent, as the deal is positioned as a logical progression in Anupam Rasayan's value chain expansion and preserves balance sheet capacity.
